x.description: Tuple of the real and imaginary parts of the input tensor. Both tensors in the tuple should be of floating type.
constraints: Both tensors in the tuple should be of floating type.

fft_length.description: An integer representing the number of the fft length. If not specified, it is inferred from the length of the last axis of `x`. Defaults to `None`.
constraints: If not specified, it is inferred from the length of the last axis of `x`.

output.description: A tensor containing the inverse real-valued Fast Fourier Transform along the last axis of `x`.
